[[File:Rico.png|thumb|250px|Rico]] '''Rico''' (Japanese: '''リョウ''' ''Ryō'') is a [[Pokémon hunter|Pokémon poacher]] and [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG006|A Poached Ego!]]''. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} found a piece of one of Rico's traps in [[Petalburg Woods]]. They later informed [[Officer Jenny]] about it when they visited a [[Pokémon Center]]. Jenny knew Rico was up to his usual evil deeds, and Ash and his friends volunteered to help her capture Rico. {{TRT}} were the first to encounter Rico after discovering his cage of poached {{p|Ekans}} hidden behind a camouflage blanket. He admitted that he was catching the {{t|Poison}} Pokémon on behalf of his clients, and demanded the trio hand over their Pokémon to guarantee their safety. The Rocket trio fought against Rico for the freedom of the Ekans and {{p|Koffing}}, but Rico defeated them, although Team Rocket managed to rescue the [[wild Pokémon]]. To be sure the Ekans and Koffing were safe, [[Jessie]] and [[James]] {{pkmn2|released}} their {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}} and {{TP|James|Weezing}} to look after them. Rico soon ran into Ash, his friends, and Officer Jenny, and was promptly arrested; in the process, he confessed that the Pokémon he had captured had all escaped, but neither he nor the others were aware of the fact that Jessie, James, and {{MTR}} had freed them. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Rico |pkmn=Fearow |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Rico Fearow.png |epnum=AG006 |epname=A Poached Ego! |desc={{p|Fearow}} alerted Rico to the [[Team Rocket trio]]'s interference with the caged {{p|Ekans}}. Shortly after this, it battled against [[James's Weezing]] and [[Jessie's Arbok]]; it ultimately lost due to {{p|Arbok}} shutting its beak with {{m|Wrap}}. Fearow was seen again a bit later beside Rico in the passenger seat of his car when Team Rocket appeared again to save the captured Pokémon. Jessie's Arbok attacked Fearow with a {{m|Headbutt}}, sending it into Rico's electrified cage, giving it a devastating electric shock. The Beak Pokémon was later defeated by [[Ash's Pikachu]]'s {{m|Thunderbolt}}. Fearow's known moves are {{m|Agility}}, {{m|Fury Attack}}, and {{m|Drill Peck}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Rico |pkmn=Tyranitar |type1=Rock |type2=Dark |img=Rico Pupitar.png |cap=Rico's Pupitar |img2=Rico Tyranitar.png |stage1=Pupitar |epnum=AG006 |epname=A Poached Ego! |vaen=Eric Stuart |vaennote=as Pupitar |desc=Rico's {{p|Tyranitar}} was first seen as a {{p|Pupitar}} during Rico's first confrontation with Team Rocket. Pupitar sent the Rocket trio blasting off with a Sandstorm attack. Rico called on Pupitar's assistance again after Team Rocket had released the stolen {{p|Ekans}} and {{p|Koffing}}. It immediately [[Evolution|evolved]] into a Tyranitar. Team Rocket found themselves helpless against this powerhouse, and told {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}} and {{TP|James|Weezing}} to lead the [[wild Pokémon]] to safety. {{MTR}} attempted to use {{m|Fury Swipes}}, [[Jessie]] and [[James]] also performed their own rendition. The trio were unrelenting in their attacks on Tyranitar, taking multiple hits and Hyper Beam attacks during the assault. After Jessie, James, and Meowth were knocked down, Rico recalled Tyranitar to chase after his catches. Later, Rico attempted to use it against {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, but he was taken down by [[Officer Jenny's Growlithe]] before he was able call it out. Tyranitar's known moves are {{m|Sandstorm}} and {{m|Hyper Beam}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{rock color}}|bordercolor={{dark color light}} |ja=中村大樹 ''Daiki Nakamura'' |en=[[Marc Thompson]] |ar=نبيل عساف ''Nabil Assaf'' |fi=Joonas Suominen |fr_eu=Arnaud Léonard |no=Christian Barmen |pl=Aleksander Gawek |pt_br=Sílvio Giraldi |es_la=Carlos Íñigo |es_eu=Pablo del Hoyo }}
